name: Fuchi Glazing
description: Fuchi Glazing is a WordPress theme designed for commercial glazing contractors, shopfitters, and architectural glass specialists. Built around an asymmetric diagonal-split hero, dual-tier navigation, and clean ledger sequences, it presents opening surveys, fixed pricing, and replacement workflows with calm clarity. All templates use native block patterns and responsive typography in Onest and DM Sans.
